# mistershell_motd (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell motd by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_motd" "example" {
  id = "123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Article content (Markdown/HTML)
- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `icon` (String) Material icon name
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to display this article
- `order` (Number) Order.
- `title` (String) Article title
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.
